He received the imamate from Abu Hashim and led a secretive network spreading Abbasid propaganda against the Umayyads from Humayma, laying the groundwork for the Abbasid revolution. He was the father of the first two Abbasid caliphs, al-Saffah and al-Mansur.
classif: father of the first two Abbasid caliphs
research_evidence: Muhammad ibn Ali died in the year 125 AH at the age of 72.
